description: Thru: five polyphonic input and output pairs, for summing stacked cables at unity and for adding sample delays

inputs.text: Everything patched here, including several stacked cables summed at unity, appears at the first output
Everything patched here appears at the output it is paired with; left unpatched, that output takes the pair above it delayed by one sample

outputs.text: Carries the input it is paired with. A signal entering the first input and taken from the fifth output arrives 5 samples late, one for each pair it passes through
